title: Role-play Extension

items.title: Choose a scenario
items.text: Keep each group’s assigned conflict or let them select a new one from slides 3–6.

items.title: Prepare two responses
items.text: Groups assign roles and rehearse one reaction that worsens the conflict and one that communicates respectfully.

items.title: Perform and compare
items.text: Groups present both versions. Discuss which response helps the team move forward and why.

items: How did the characters’ feelings shape their responses?
What did the more respectful response change?

source_note: Additional role-play for original Part 04 conflict scenario slides. No new scenarios or additional student worksheets; teacher companion, not a core DO step.
intro: Use a conflict scenario to practise responses that help or harm teamwork.
